comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This quest is actually available from the following Adventure Mediators:

Stockholm (all players)
Amsterdam (must have discovered Siberian Husky; part of the Xanadu chain)
London (must have discovered Xanadu)

But considering the Xanadu chain has about 60+ discoveries to open it, it's really better to just go for Stockholm so you can begin the Atlantis series of quests up sooner.
